deferral_rationale: Reconcile r3 severity downgrade BLOCKER->CONCERN: the heal branch is causally verify-gated — upload_report_2474.json is written only AFTER both verify_repo_paths_uploaded calls pass (fit.py:2482-2499; pinned by tests/test_issue2474_fit_pins.py:325-334, a verify miss leaves NO report), and the completion fingerprint's per-file mtime_ns (fit.py:2434-2438) confines the skip to the same filesystem/pod that performed the verified upload — a fresh pod or checkout always mismatches and re-uploads. Remote deletion after a verified upload is equally undetected on the fully-successful path (the sentinel already exists there), and plan.md:228 requires independent upload verification (outroot=/rows= tokens) before pod terminate — the backstop that catches a missing mirror. Residual hardening kept as CONCERN: completion_fp omits repo_id + destination prefixes (a future destination-constant change with unchanged local artifacts would false-skip) and the heal branch could cheaply re-verify remote paths before re-writing the sentinel; update the tests/test_issue2474_fit_pins.py:337-351 pin in the same fix.
